notes.title: Patch #2 is live! (And there's a cheeky little discount on the bundle)
notes.notes:

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49942/Techno_Banter_Ultimate_Mix/]To celebrate this, we decided to discount the Ultimate Mix bundle by 25%.[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Patch #1 just made its way into Rainbow Drive!
notes.notes:
Dropping the promised patch, just in time for the weekend!

If you were waiting a little while for us to implement a few fixes before buying, but still wanted to take advantage of the [b]-20% Launch Discount[/b], this is the perfect moment!

As previously mentioned, and without further ado, here are the patchnotes!

[h1]Patch #1:[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Invert Y axis setting, for all fighter jet enthusiasts
[*]Alternative controls for minigames (Arrow keys for Movement, Right Shift for Dash!)[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Nill should appear in correct clothes (or without them) in all places in the game
[*]Restored animations on Nill Status Wheel (for some reason, our beary kind friend doesn't react at all!)
[*]Visual and functional rework of Skills Menu, to adjust it to how the conversation Skill Wheel works
[*]Visual improvements here and there![/list]

As always, please feel free to reach out to us either directly on our [url=https://discord.gg/vMmdpuTk]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2348400/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].

[b]If you like Techno Banter, we'd really appreciate you leaving a review![/b]

notes.title: The Hotfix is here!
notes.notes:
Seeing you all explore Rainbow Drive and become absolute rulers of the Green Door queue has warmed our hearts beyond words, and we couldn't be more thankful for all your feedback!

That being said, we wanted to address (and fix) the issues you have been reporting throughout the Launch Weekend, so here it is! 

[h1]The first patch for Techno Banter![/h1]

This hotfix aims to address all the issues connected to progressing through the game:
[list]
[*] Fixed inability to select certain dialogue options using the controller
[*] Fixed soft-lock caused by using skills without the required hype level
[*] Fixed inability to progress through the Red Flags explanation during the dialogue with Gunthy
[/list]

If you run into any more pesky bugs, feel free to reach out to us either through our Discord server, our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2348400]Community Hub[/url] or directly to our team at support@crunchingkoalas.com
